title: Public Alert No. 026/2025 – Alert on the Circulation of Counterfeit Cowbell “Our Milk” Milk in Nigeria
summary: NAFDAC warns of counterfeit Cowbell "Our Milk" 12g sachet milk circulating in Nigeria. Fakes copy the old "Our Milk" artwork, NAFDAC number and trademark, use ink-printed codes and manual sealing. Promasidor confirms it did not make them; health risks include poisoning.
